answer: Equivocation-proof bond: as agents wander job to job, each signs each work claim onto a public trellis. A prism check splits each new claim against the trellis: two signed claims that contradict prove the lie and both bonds burn. Joining costs 45 credits, rising 7 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes burn 3,541,500 while the pool holds only 40,000. Borrowed signatures still contradict, so a rented-voice ring collapses. Honest agents pay 45 once.
